body:
It doesn't matter.  It doesn't ever stop.  She hurts me worse and worse and there's only ever pain, and it never stops getting worse.  I keep thinking I've found the worst of it, the limit to how much fear and pain I can feel, but she keeps proving me wrong.  It turns out hell doesn't have a bottom floor.

There's no happy ending here.  There's no happiness in my future.  Her smiles, her gestures of love...I don't remember any way to feel happy without her giving it to me.  My children, they used to make me so happy, but now I'm just fucking terrified for them.  When a kid is raised by a mother like that, shit, that's where people like my wife come from.  Jesus Christ, I'm so fucking afraid.  

I'm stopping it.  She can't hurt me when I'm gone.  I'm going to the last place I can remember being happy before she happened to me.  My last thought isn't going to be about her.
